1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件（基于搜索）：

  • Memorial Day: U.S. stock market closed, only futures + global markets trading; CME futures half-day session.
  • Trump posts ultra-long thread on Truth Social: Bundling the Iran deal with the expansion of the Abraham Accords, "mandatorily requesting" Saudi, Qatar, Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt, Jordan, UAE, and Bahrain to collectively sign normalization agreements with Israel, hinting that Iran could also join.
  • Iran Foreign Ministry spokesperson Baghaei simultaneously cools expectations: Explicitly stating "a deal is far from imminent," emphasizing that "we are not discussing nuclear issues, the focus is on ending the war," and threatening that "if the U.S. continues to interfere, the deal will be completely canceled."
  • Rubio pivots, saying "deal could come Monday," contradicting Trump’s "time on our side" narrative.
  • Iran creative wordplay: "Strait of Hormuz won't charge a toll, but will charge an 'environmental fee'"; the "environmental fee" meme appeared overnight in the community.
  • ES +0.9%, NQ +1.4%, Brent ~$96-98, WTI ~$92; crude oil down 5-6%, 10Y yields retreating.
  • Iran claims to have shot down a "hostile drone" over the Gulf—market ignores it.

社区氛围：强烈牛气+自嘲混乱。熊被屠杀而屈服； “banbets”的失败者正在排队（QCOM 250、MU 800/1069、NVDA 250、SPY 695、ADBE 300、UVIX 8.5、BNO 60 全部失败）。然而，明显的“理性牛”声音已经出现：长文指出“大盘涨1%并不可怕，可怕的是不肯跌”。

恐惧/贪婪指数估计：85/100（极度贪婪）。 NQ逼近3万大关； “SPY 800/$1000 EOM”已成为日常口号；许多多头自己也开始说“太乐观了，感到不安”。

社区情绪与现实：社区对“环境费”模因+期货收益感到非常兴奋，但同时也在问自己“什么时候会逆转？” “推销新闻”的假说越来越受到关注：许多人指出，实际签署的日子可能是最好的一天。与实际市场相比，期货仅实现了预期“+3%”涨幅的1/3，欧洲市场下午开始走弱，为周二开盘奠定基础。
